subject: ONE barrel sponge creature, porous orange body, stubby arms, one big round eye, free in open water, never fixed to rock
second_characters: ONE crab courier hurling parcels at him every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp whipping across the lens

props.big: ONE fat leather wallet held in his arms, swelling as he swallows
props.small: A SWARM of small brown parcels hurtling at the lens and into his pores

environment: open blue water over a reef, kelp and crates top and bottom, shoals and bubbles blowing through
lighting: bright daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his eye never under a quarter of it, always within an arm of the lens. The world flies at him: parcels, crates, shoals and the second characters tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, a new shot size each beat, medium to close. He holds his spot but throws body and arms the full frame width to meet what is thrown. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word ноль done by 6.10, then water and claws carry it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ko-she-LYOK, GUB-ka, vpi-TY-va-et, pod-RYAD, vy-da-YOT, NOL

timeline.a: already swallowing: a parcel drives into his side and vanishes, his body ballooning to twice its width, the wallet locked in his arms; the crab hurls the next across the lens
he swings the swollen wallet overhead through the parcel stream, the shrimp whipping across the lens
he throws both arms the full frame width and pulls three flying parcels into his pores, eye filling the frame, crates tearing behind; the crab flings another at his face
he hauls the bulging wallet down under his eye, the crab dragging his arm the other way
he wrenches the wallet wide open at the lens, nothing inside but water, the shrimp tearing under his chin
he grips his own body with both arms and wrings it, pores gushing dirty water the full frame width; the crab reels back through the spray
he wrings harder and dives his wrung body at the lens, ONE dull coin squeezing out past his eye
the crab snatches that coin and hurls a fresh parcel at him, the shrimp crossing the lens
he catches that parcel full width and swallows it, swelling again, the empty wallet flapping in his arm
he turns the wallet inside out at the lens, crates rushing, the crab hauling at it
he shakes the turned-out wallet over his eye, one bubble leaving it, the shrimp whipping past

must_appear: the hero fills half the frame height start to end; at 0.00 the parcel already vanishing into him, his body swelling; at 6.80 water gushing from his pores; at 9.60 the wallet plainly empty and inside out by his eye
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, spoken digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a sponge fixed to a rock, a hero held in one pose, a prop worked in place, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a sideways travelling camera or dolly, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, dark scene, studio lighting, a cut to another location, the hero's back to the camera, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 6.10, offscreen narration, English speech, a second sponge
